title: CONNECT-UDP Early Datagram Policy Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9298 early HTTP Datagram drop/buffer behavior, buffering-limit policy, and optimistic client datagram sending before response.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectUdpEarlyDatagramPolicy` classifies datagrams that arrive before their request as silent drop or temporary buffer, requires buffering limits when buffering is used, and records the client-side permission to send optimistic datagrams before receiving the proxy response.
data_and_state_considerations: The policy is stateless and leaves actual buffer implementation and capacity accounting to the live adapter.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Known-request datagrams are processed rather than classified as early.
Unknown-request datagrams can only be dropped or temporarily buffered.
risks: Live buffering queues and round-trip timers remain adapter work.
Live request association remains in the tunnel forwarding slice.
